record.bible_text: <FO><FO>Maschil<WH04905><WTH8688> of David<WH01732>; A Prayer<WH08605> when he was in the cave<WH04631>.<Fo><Fo> I cried<WH02199><WTH8799> unto the LORD<WH03068> with my voice<WH06963>; with my voice<WH06963> unto the LORD<WH03068> did I make my supplication<WH02603><WTH8691>. <RF>Maschil...: or, A Psalm of David, giving instruction<Rf>
